storyInfo: Matoimaru rushes home just to stop her father from falling for a racket. Astonishingly, the proof she brings is met with disbelief, so she makes a bold decision...

attributes.content: *pant*... *pant*... Matoimaru, tell me... we're almost there...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Yeah, real soon!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Pick up the pace! We've gotta stop him before he gives that scammer any more money!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Dammit, I'm not gonna let him do this...
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: *pant*... I've never heard you... talk about your family before...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: What's your dad like...? Some kinda... super-burly Oni hulk?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Cause if he is... I dunno if I'll be any help talking him down...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Relax, Dad's not an Oni, just your average old Vulpo.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: He adopted me when I was real young—didn't care I had Oni horns growing in. He raised me all the way.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: I'm not gonna let him get dragged into any of the messes I've made since leaving home, so I've never really brought him up.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: But since he’s the one who caused this mess, there’s nothing I can do.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Doesn't matter how, we've gotta get it through his skull he's being duped!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Scams like this have been on the rise in Higashi lately... I saw the news in Mitsukue reporting on it...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: It's scary to think... Even your relative got hit...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Good thing you guys investigate fast. I woulda been way too late on my own.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: We're here! This is the village!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru maintains her breakneck sprint, her operator companion huffing for air as he straggles behind. The Higashinese village is still and quiet, a vista of peace in the rays of early summer.
A villager in thin clothes emerges onto the path to hail the two, only to halt upon seeing Matoimaru, whereupon he begins to wave enthusiastically.
Yo! If it isn't Matoimaru-chan! Finally made time to come back and visit us?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Villager

attributes.content: Hold on, what's the rush? Somewhere to be?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Villager

attributes.content: No time to chat! I gotta get home fast!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru completely forgoes the usual pleasantries with the old man, merely jabbing in the direction of her house before dashing away from him.
The man stumbles back a step out of surprise, and shakes his head as he watches the Oni girl go.
Gone for so many years, and now she's suddenly racing for home? Is Eikichi in trouble?
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Villager

attributes.content: ...Surely not. Eikichi's not the trouble-finding sort.
attributes.name: Enthusiastic Villager

attributes.content: Excuse me, sir, I'm sorry about this... Once I have the chance, I'll explain what happened...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Hold up, Matoimaru!
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Watching the two figures speed off, the villager scratched his head in confusion.
And honestly, 'fake'? How can this be fake?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: All I had to pay was a small processing fee, and they sent me the first payout just the day before. I've hit the jackpot, true and honest.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: It's a fine opportunity, and I've no reason to pass it up—
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: What? You already gave them the money?
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru! I told you to stay out of this—why did you come back anyway?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: You come home without a word, and look, you just barrel in! Look at the door! Look at the flower vase you knocked over! See?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Honestly, girl. Never mind the damage—what baffles me is I finally come into some wealth and all you want is to pull me away from it.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: What do you want me to tell you, huh?!
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Says you, Dad! I explained it to you and you still ignored me!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Lotteries like these are scams. I saw the exact same grift when I went to Kazimierz.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: I've been around more than you now. It's your turn to listen to me. I'm serious. This is gonna screw you.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: In fact, I'm so serious, I brought a coworker you can trust with me, he's... he should be here real soon.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: We've looked into the scammer! We even know where he is, and what he's up to! That has to convince you, right?!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Yes, yes, Matoimaru, you've been places.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: But you've been out there so long, you missed how Higashi changed. You don’t know what it’s like for us.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: And don't tell me about Kazimierz. I know about Kazimierz, but this isn't Kazimierz. Higashi is in its boom era now, understand.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: And you should learn to stop crying scam at every little thing. Remember Katsushi next door? I let you play at his place all the time when you were young.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: He hit the jackpot too. He doesn't even live here anymore. I bet he's flying free in Mitsukue right about now.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Dad, be real for a sec!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Doesn't matter where in the land you are, you only get as much back as the effort you put in. I learned that in my very first year away from home.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: It's because things are so much cushier now, because so many people want a quick and easy fortune, that all these scammers crawled outta the woodwork!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: You can't give into greed like that! It just makes you into another mark!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Enough, enough! How can it be fake when I already got a payout? If this is how it's going to be, just get back to your job.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Look, once I get all the money, maybe you won't have to break your back out there anymore. We can move to the city and have ourselves an easy life.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Okay? Stop letting your anger speak for you.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Hold on... *pant*...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Sorry... Matoimaru... didn't think you lived this deep in the mountains...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Nice to... meet you, sir... I'm a colleague of Matoimaru's here...
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Finally! Quick, help me talk to him! I suck at explaining all the details!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Listen to him, okay, Dad? We did the investigation. We know the truth. You'll understand once you hear it!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: No, I know everything I need to. You're wasting your time, no?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: (Takes a deep breath)
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: On the contrary, sir. Details in your letter raised Matoimaru's suspicions, and we amassed copious evidence while aiding her investigation to back our findings.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Scams disguised as notices of lottery wins have been reported all over Higashi. Did you receive a message telling you to pay a handling fee before you could receive your reward?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Just a little processing fee, yes. But look, I already got some money out from it, right?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: How can this be a racket if they're paying me?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: That's one of the methods these fraudsters use. They pay their victims part of the money, before asking you to pay even larger handling fees, bit by bit.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: We've already tracked down where your messages are coming from, based on how previous incidents of this kind played out. The source is an insurance firm in Mitsukue.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: If you could take a look here, these messages are all from the operating committee for a television program called 'Fortune 24/7', right?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: But the reality is, someone from that firm is posing as this committee in order to send out these fabricated messages.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: We advise you that you cannot trust any future communications that come from them, and you cannot continue to meet their demands.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Thank you!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: See, here's an in-depth report from the Mitsukue papers. These are all the fake notices other people got, saying they'd won. They're basically the same as yours, aren't they?
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: You HAVE to believe us now!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru pulls paper after paper from the operator's binder, and lays them all out on the tatami for her foster father to see.
She watches earnestly to see how he'll react, only for him to shake his head.
Settle down, Matoimaru.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: You know we've never been wealthy. This is a chance for us to live the good life...
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: And none of the stuff you're showing me can prove the jackpot I hit isn't real.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Just go, the both of you. Don't try and test me with this rubbish.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Dad, even I learned not to get duped like I used to! How can you fall for this kind of scam?!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: You—
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Abruptly, Eikichi rises, and pushes Matoimaru out the door with both hands.
Enough! I have a life to live! Don't you bother me anymore!
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Sir, please calm down! Sir!
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: But the operator's exhortations make Eikichi no less eager to get Matoimaru out.
She doesn't put up a fight. Removed from the room, she and her father stare each other down for a few fractious seconds, before she silently turns and leaves.
The operator can only hurry to gather up the scattered papers from the floor, before apologizing as he slips out of the room.
*Sigh*!
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: On seeing how the two have knocked over the entryway ornaments, Eikichi stamps a foot and sighs.
Matoimaru!
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Don't give up. It's not over just because we didn't convince him. After all, it's true we don't have decisive evidence.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: We're limited in how much we can investigate. Maybe we can wait for the authorities to step in after all.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: The operator flips through his binder, poring over all the evidence within, failing to notice when Matoimaru suddenly lifts her head.
No. It's not catching the scammer that matters most. It's getting Dad to understand this whole thing's a racket.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Right, I've got it, the most decisive evidence there is...
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: If the scammer himself admits it, then there's no way Dad can keep claiming his win is real!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: What are you implying?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: We're gonna go to Mitsukue right now, and we're gonna get that sucker.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: I'll make him confess, straight from the burdenbeast's mouth!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: What? Matoimaru, we don't have the authority to just seize people like that. Without a warrant from the authorities, we—
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Don't worry, I've got a plan. It starts now!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: C'mon, stick with me!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru!
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: We can take the car this time! Matoimaru!
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Mitsukue, in the afternoon...
A speeding car brakes to a lurching stop outside an insurance firm, and the operator almost flies out of the passenger seat from the inertia.
We're finally here. You're sure that asshole works here?
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Guh... Are you sure you're licensed to drive?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Whatever, I guess that bridge is crossed. Yes, as long as our results are sound, he's definitely in there.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: But we still don't have confirmation of who he is exactly, and I don't think it's a good idea to just barge into their office like this.
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: I told you, I've got a plan.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Listen to me. You stay in the car, and keep in contact. I'll head in solo to handle things. We can't go letting 'em catch sight of Rhodes Island's uniform.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: They'll think I'm just some Oni thug from the Mitsukue, here to see someone. Nobody'll even try to stop me.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: People who only have the spine for dirty methods like this are all cowards. He'll fold just from the fright. I'll nab him, just you watch.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Are you sure about this? What if he clams up and won't confess?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: Relax. When in Higashi, do as the Higashinese do. He'd probably run if the police came to make an arrest, but if he hears the Mafioso came knocking, he'll be REAL desperate to play nice.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Plus, we've got proof. It didn't win over Dad, but it'll definitely convince that little scammer there's eyes on him.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Sit tight, and I'll drag him out in a sec!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: With that, Matoimaru swiftly hops out of the car, and strides for the office entrance.
How do I even write the mission report...?
attributes.name: Rhodes Island Operator

attributes.content: It's afternoon in a small Higashinese firm, and its suited-up office workers are all buried in their desk work.
Suddenly, the sound of heavy stomping makes everyone lift their heads and look to the entrance.
There stands a robust Oni wielding a naginata, and on her left is the front desk receptionist in a stiff bow, looking somewhat hapless.
Listen close, I'm only gonna say it once! I'm here for someone!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: The Oni's sudden bark, her voice loud and clear, makes everyone sit up straight in their seats.
One of you has been posing as the 'Fortune 24/7' Operation Committee, sending out a LOT of scam jackpot wins telling folks they'll get their prize as soon as they fork over a handler's fee.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Smells like someone's awful keen on getting rich. It's a nasty way to do it, I won't lie.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Well. I dunno who else you swindled, and right now, I don't care. But how dare you come after us!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: We tracked you down from the notice you sent. You got nowhere to run.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Now step up and fess up! And even if you don't, you can't escape us forever. If we sniff you out, we'll sure you know what kinda treatment you get for not following our rules!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: The Oni's grip on her naginata tightens. Each time one of her sentences ends, the office is silent enough to hear a pin drop. The desk workers are too terrified to even look away.
Following a brief hush, a single hand in the corner of the workplace slowly raises, and quivers as it weaves through the maze of desks and mountains of papers, eventually arriving before the Oni.
I beg you, please spare me...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: I'll do anything you ask... I don't want to die...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: The Oni looks over the fearful, stooped man. Her expression remains stonily fixed. She pulls out a sheet of paper from her bag, and unfolds it in front of the employee.
You the one sending these notices?
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: The employee timidly lifts his gaze, once-overs the words on the page, and nods promptly.
The naginata-wielding Oni says nothing more, dragging him backwards out of the office by his collar.
The silence in the building hangs for a while longer. Then it breaks, and the entire street can hear the sheer commotion coming from within.
*sigh*... Finally got it all arranged again. I put her own ikebana display here—can't be wrecking that.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: But it's strange. They should've sent me my winnings by now, but I haven't heard a single thing from them since.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: No, stop it. Katsushi got his payout, didn't he? Dammit, why did he have to vanish? If I could just ask him...
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Eikichi paces the room, deep in contemplation, when he hears a familiar voice once more outside his door.
We're here, you little bastard! You're gonna apologize to my dad, personally! Are we clear?!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Dad, I caught the scammer for you!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: You can hear it straight from his mouth just how he swindled the cash.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Get talking!
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Wh-What's the meaning of this?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Eikichi looks down, and only then sees the suited man Matoimaru's dragged in with her. His face is deathly pale, and utterly fixed with fright.
Matoimaru, let him go! Look, you've scared the daylights out of him!
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: No, no, sir, please, I really did do it.
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: And I shouldn't have, not in a million years, not when it meant swindling you! I take all the blame!
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: I beg you, tell your daughter not to kill me! I was short on money and desperate—so desperate I thought up this scam of all things...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: Hmm? How does that add up?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Isn't that Fortune 24/7 program supposed to be famous in Mitsukue?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: No, sir, it was a guise for me to fool people. Trick them with talk of jackpots, and then once people in Mitsukue got wise to it, I moved to looking outside the city...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: This coward kept his demands low at first, scared he'd be found out.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: But once he discovered people outside Mitsukue don't have a clue about programs like this, he found way easier marks, so he began sending fake notices all over.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: The—um, everyone around me had the cash to live it up, and I just wanted that too...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: If I had more money, I wouldn't need to work in that cramped little office, and I wouldn't need to live cooped up in my stuffy little room...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: So where's the money? Sounds like you're not exactly living it up yet.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Don't laugh at me, I...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: Every time I got the money, I'd blow it all on cards and pachinko, and lose it all. I couldn't think of any other ways to get rich...
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: We work in insurance, so it's easy to get the customers' contact details. All we need is a name, and it's not hard to gain their trust.
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: Dad, if all that evidence before wasn't enough, you just heard the scammer confess it himself. No room for doubt now, right?
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: This was always a racket from the very beginning. You can't trust get-rich-quick crap like this.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: But... but if it was fake, then what about the money Katsushi got?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Surely you're not telling me you forced an innocent man to confess to guilt?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Matoimaru, this is a line you just can't cross...
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: She did no such thing, sir, you have to believe me! You have to, or it's my head!
attributes.name: Nervous Worker

attributes.content: A younger me might've pulled some stupid stunt, Dad.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: But my colleagues helped me uncover the evidence, and only then did I have the guts to haul this scammer out.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Besides—
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Before Matoimaru can finish, a woman's shrill voice filters in from outside.
Get out here, you swindler! Matoimaru, bring him to me this instant!
Is... is that Akiyo?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Eikichi opens the door, only to be taken aback by a sizeable congregation of fellow villagers at his doorstep, his neighbor Katsushi's wife Akiyo at their fore.
Friends, what's going on here?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: I haven't seen you in a long time, Akiyo. What brings you back? Where's Katsushi? Why isn't he with you?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Eikichi-nii, I owe a very deep debt of thanks to your Matoimaru.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: If it weren't for her, I'd have gone the rest of my life not knowing where this waste of breath went.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: Just now, Shigezou-ojisan caught sight of her lugging this cur back, her coworker explained the whole situation to him, and he came running over to our place.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: Until then, I had no idea the man who scammed my Katsushi was back again and cheating you too.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: Thanks to Matoimaru, we've finally caught the scoundrel!
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: What? Katsushi was scammed, you say? Then why did he never tell me? Why did you never tell me?
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Didn't he win the jackpot and move away? I haven't seen hide nor hair of him in forever! I thought you'd gone with him!
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: How could I tell you? Not only did he never get the money, he was swindled to the point we almost lost our house and home.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: After that, he went out looking for work to repay the debt, and I've not heard from him since.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: How humiliating would it be if people learned of this, especially now that I'm on my own? How could I tell you, or anyone? I could only hole up and bear it alone at home.
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: Now I hear the cheat's finally been caught—I can... finally...
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: At that point, Akiyo's shrill voice falters, and the young wife breaks down in tears in front of everyone.
The villagers stare at the fraudster lying trembling on the ground, and at the stunned Eikichi in his doorway, and begin to murmur.
Goodness, look. Look at what he's driven poor Akiyo to.
attributes.name: Onlooking Villager

attributes.content: The man's obviously a habitual crook! Just can't help himself, no matter how many he deceives! It's about time he was taught a lesson!
attributes.name: Enraged Villager

attributes.content: Exactly. How could anyone forgive him?
attributes.name: Onlooking Villager

attributes.content: Matoimaru! Give this swindler a real what-for! Don't stop beating him until he can't draw breath!
attributes.name: Enraged Villager
Onlooking Villager
attributes.content: Beat him!

attributes.name: Onlooking Villager
attributes.content: Beat him!
Little by little, the villagers lift their voices in clamor. Again and again, the man bows as low as he can, his face pale as death, but he can no longer squeeze out any pleas for forgiveness.
In contrast, Matoimaru simply shakes her head before approaching Eikichi.
Calm down, everyone. This man's been out of control, I agree. He's hurt who-knows-how-many just for money. He even swindled my dad. I'm as pissed as you are.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: But I didn't drag him here so anyone could vent on him.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: If beating the crap out of him would've solved everything, then his breaths would've been numbered by the time I found him in Mitsukue.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru...
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: I brought him here so others could learn not to get scammed as easy as I used to.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: But... we can't just—let this scoundrel go...
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: All the money he cheated us out of...
attributes.name: Akiyo

attributes.content: Akiyo-nee, trust me, this guy's not escaping punishment, and there'll be settlement for all the money lost.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: No matter what's happened, things WILL get better from now on.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Police sirens wail from the road outside the village. Matoimaru looks past the crowd and over toward the binder-toting operator who catches her gaze and nods the sign to her.
And don’t fret. People will be here real soon to handle him.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: The sky begins to darken. The police apprehend and take away the fraudster. Soon, the crowd surrounding Eikichi's door disperses.
As a stick of bug-repellent incense burns, a small room is now host to no one but father and daughter. Eikichi sits in seiza on the tatami flooring, not quite certain where to rest his gaze.
Say, um. Matoimaru, you know. Your dad's been a fool. Shouldn't have gone blaming you like that.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Almost fell for that rotten gambler's scheme. Made a fool of myself in front of the whole village.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: *sigh* I've no right to judge. I was blinded by the quick money, just like...
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Matoimaru sits next to him, and listens. In lieu of an immediate response, she silently shuffles closer, until she's close enough they could lean on each other.
What're ya talking about, Dad? Doesn't matter if you got scammed. Just don't fall for it again.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: If I was the old me, I woulda been no help. Bet I'd be stumped where he even got his hooks into you.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: And besides...
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: The Oni girl awkwardly reaches over and holds Eikichi's hand resting on the tatami floor, as her face breaks into a grin.
Life's changed. I'm not a kid anymore. It's my turn to look after you now, Dad.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Eikichi glances at his adopted daughter, and his taut expression finally begins to relax.
Say, there's one more thing.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: What you said to the village folk when they were calling for that cheat to be taught a lesson? That didn't sound like something you'd say.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: Sure you didn't rough him up in secret? A younger you would never have let his kind off the hook, you know.
attributes.name: Matoimaru's Foster Father

attributes.content: I told you, Dad. Someday I'd stop being that gullible little dummy.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: And hey, you know the saying?
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Even the most vicious Oni will discover peace someday.
attributes.name: Matoimaru

attributes.content: Matoimaru turns her head, and glances over at the entryway with its warm lights overhead. There on a wooden shelf, her very own ikebana has been put on display.
